description: Decide on a suggested time entry from time-entries.suggestions.list. `decision.type: accept` records a time entry with the given minutes and narrative (source `suggested`) and keeps the suggestion's evidence with the decision; it fails with 409 when the fingerprint is no longer pending for that day. `decision.type: dismiss` hides the suggestion for good and is idempotent: repeating it returns the decision already stored, including an earlier accept.

date.description: Day the suggestions are computed for (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

billable.description: Whether the entry is billable to the client

durationMinutes.description: Minutes to record; the suggestion's engaged minutes unless edited

anyOf.description: BCP-47 language tag, or null when unspecified

decision.description: `accept` records a time entry from the suggestion; `dismiss` hides it for good

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of a suggestion from time-entries.suggestions.list

timezoneId.description: IANA time zone that bounds the day (e.g. Europe/Prague); an accepted entry is dated in it
